title: Paz Vizsla
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: A brawny warrior bearing heavy weapons, Paz Vizsla served in the same, secret Mandalorian covert as The Mandalorian Din Djarin, remaining ever faithful to the wisdom and teachings of The Armorer. As a descendent of the esteemed House Viszla, he bore a legacy of leaders taht spanned centuries of Mandalorian History. He once challenged Din Djarin for possession of the Darksaber, but became one of his loyal allies.
